name: Dirt-Caked Pendant
summary: In the Barrens, a captive orc gives up the Dirt-Caked Pendant he carried. The keepsake reaches Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar, where it is used to draw a succubus.

sections.title: A Tragic Token
sections.body: Dogran gives up the Dirt-Caked Pendant while held captive in the Barrens. Poisoned and crippled beyond recovery, he will not return to his mate, Zankaja, as a burden. He chooses to die fighting his captors instead. The pendant carries his unspoken love for her. A warlock takes the keepsake to Orgrimmar, where the warlocks of the Cleft of Shadow put its heartbreak and devotion to use.

sections.title: Bait for a Demon
sections.body: In the Cleft of Shadow, Gan'rul Bloodeye sees how the pendant can draw a succubus. These demons are drawn to mortal yearning, romance, and tragedy. The warlock cleans and polishes Dogran's pendant until it shines, turning a token of devoted love into a lure. The warlock then calls a succubus forth to face ritual combat and be dominated.

faq.q: Where does the Dirt-Caked Pendant come from?
aliases: where do i get the pendant
faq.answer: Dogran, a captive orc warrior in the Barrens, hands you the pendant after you give him Ken'zigla's draught and revive his senses.

faq.q: What is the pendant's connection to Zankaja?
faq.answer: Zankaja is Dogran's mate in Orgrimmar. He gives up the pendant and hides that he survived so she will not have to care for him as an invalid warrior.

faq.q: Why does Gan'rul Bloodeye need this specific pendant?
faq.answer: Succubi are drawn to powerful mortal feelings, especially romance, heartbreak, and devotion. Once cleaned, Dogran's pendant can focus the call that draws a succubus into the summoning circle.

faq.q: What happens after the pendant is delivered to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: After you deliver the pendant to Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye cleans it and uses its allure to begin The Binding. A succubus is drawn into the circle beneath the Cleft of Shadow for you to defeat and subjugate.

angles.text: As a warlock in training, you see how mortal grief and devotion can help command demons from the Twisting Nether.
As an orc, you see Dogran's bittersweet choice: he refuses to burden his clan and mate as a cripple, giving up his keepsake to make a warrior's final stand.
